title: Cubarsí v Puyol, Piqué and Ramos at the same age
checked: Barcelona v Man City, Champions League, Camp Nou, 8 Dec 2026 (FC Barcelona + On Tour). Cubarsí born 22 Jan 2007 = 19y 320d that day. 2026 World Cup: Spain beat Argentina 1-0 after extra time in the final, 19 Jul 2026; Cubarsí played every minute of Spain's eight games; Spain conceded one goal all tournament (FC Barcelona + Wikipedia + The Analyst + Football España). FIFA Young Player Award 2026 (Football España + FC Barcelona). Earlier defender winners: Beckenbauer 1966, Żmuda 1974, Cabrini 1978, Amoros 1982, and every winner since 1986 is a midfielder or forward (FIFA list on Wikipedia + IANS/DT Next), so 'first defender since 1982'; the old draft's 'first defender ever' was wrong. First Barcelona goal: Barça 4-4 Atlético, Copa del Rey semi-final first leg, 25 Feb 2025, header at the far post from Raphinha's corner, 1-2 to 2-2 (FC Barcelona + Sky Sports). Same age: Puyol (born 13 Apr 1978) 27 Feb 1998, no first-team games, debut 2 Oct 1999 at Valladolid aged 21 (Wikipedia + FC Barcelona); Piqué (born 2 Feb 1987) 19 Dec 2006, on loan at Real Zaragoza from Man United (Wikipedia + Bleacher Report); Ramos (born 30 Mar 1986) 13 Feb 2006, first season at Real Madrid after joining from Sevilla in 2005 (Wikipedia + Sevilla FC). World Cup final ages by arithmetic: Puyol 32, Piqué 23, Ramos 24 on 11 Jul 2010; Cubarsí 19 on 19 Jul 2026. Spain debut ages: Cubarsí 17 (Mar 2024 v Colombia), Ramos 18 (26 Mar 2005 v China), Puyol 22 (15 Nov 2000 v Netherlands), Piqué 22 (11 Feb 2009 v England) (Wikipedia + RFEF-based lists). Atlético's kit in the recreated goal is assumed. First-team games 139 to 31 Oct 2026 (FotMob + Wikipedia).

lines.text: When Barcelona host Manchester City on the eighth of December, Pau Cubarsí will be nineteen years and three hundred and twenty days old.
lines.say: When Barselona host Manchester City on the eighth of December, Pow Koobarsee will be nineteen years, and three hundred and twenty days old.

lines.text: This summer, Spain won the World Cup. One-nil against Argentina, after extra time.
lines.say: This summer, Spain won the World Cup. One nil against Argentina, after extra time.

lines.text: Cubarsí played every minute of all eight games. Spain let in one goal in the whole tournament.
lines.say: Koobarsee played every minute of all eight games. Spain let in one goal, in the whole tournament.

lines.text: FIFA named him the best young player of the tournament. The first defender since nineteen eighty-two.
lines.say: FIFA named him the best young player of the tournament. The first defender since nineteen eighty two.

scene.headline: Cubarsí named the World Cup's best young player
scene.standfirst: The Barcelona centre-back is the first defender to win the award since Manuel Amoros in 1982.

lines.text: And when Barça needed a goal against Atlético, the defender went up for Raphinha's corner, and headed in his first.
lines.say: And when Barsa needed a goal against Atletico, the defender went up for Rafeenya's corner, and headed in his first.

lines.text: Now Spain's great centre-backs at the same age. Carles Puyol, February ninety-eight.
lines.say: Now, Spain's great centre backs, at the same age. Karlus Pooyol. February, ninety eight.

lines.text: Barcelona first-team games? Zero. His debut came at twenty-one.
lines.say: Barselona first team games? Zero. His debut came at twenty one.

lines.text: Gerard Piqué, December two thousand and six: on loan at Zaragoza.
lines.say: Zherar Peekay. December, two thousand and six. On loan at Tharagotha.

lines.text: Sergio Ramos, February two thousand and six: first season at Real Madrid, no trophies yet.
lines.say: Serhyo Ramoss. February, two thousand and six. First season at Real Madrid, no trophies yet.

lines.text: Spain debuts? Cubarsí was seventeen. Ramos eighteen. Puyol and Piqué, twenty-two.
lines.say: Spain debuts? Koobarsee was seventeen. Ramoss, eighteen. Pooyol and Peekay, twenty two.

lines.text: All four became world champions. Cubarsí did it thirteen years younger than Puyol.
